# Morita Tarvirdians

> PhD researcher at TU Delft (Interactive Intelligence group, Hybrid Intelligence consortium) working on
> conversational agents that support human reflection during high-stakes personal decisions. Also the creator
> of Morita DataLand, a bilingual Persian and English data science channel on YouTube.

Core claim of the research: an AI system can observe the structure of a person's reasoning but not its
meaning. The design principle that follows is "surface, do not steer" — make the observation visible and let
the person interpret it.

## Pages

- [Home](https://moritatarvirdians.com/): positioning, selected papers, latest videos.
- [Research](https://moritatarvirdians.com/research.html): all publications, projects, teaching, talks.
- [Morita DataLand](https://moritatarvirdians.com/videos.html): the YouTube channel and its open notebooks.
- [Writing](https://moritatarvirdians.com/writing/): essays on decisions and human-AI reflection.
- [Coaching](https://moritatarvirdians.com/coaching.html): a reflective decision coaching practice opening in 2027.
- [About](https://moritatarvirdians.com/about.html): full biography, background, copy-ready bios.

## Key publications

- Why This and Not That? A Collaborative Reflection Approach for Understanding Thought Coverage in Decision
  Making Support Dialog. Findings of EMNLP 2026. https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.17054
- Reflecti-Mate: A Conversational Agent for Adaptive Decision-Making Support Through System 1 and System 2
  Thinking. ACM UMAP 2026. https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22509
- Reflection Before Action: Designing a Framework for Quantifying Thought Patterns for Increased
  Self-awareness in Personal Decision Making. Preprint, 2025. https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04364
